# Doctor Pinkheart

Doctor Pinkheart is a background earth pony mare from *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic*. She is one of the doctors in Ponyville Hospital's chaotic operating-room scene during Applejack's childhood flashback.

- **Appearance:** Very pale pink coat, reddish-orange mane, and deep magenta eyes. She appears in a surgical setting. Her cutie mark is not verified.
- **Name:** Doctor Pinkheart is the identification used by the [Earth pony character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares). No official naming source, original naming attribution, or alternate identity was verified; treat it as a fandom/catalog name rather than established spoken canon.
- **Speaking status:** Apparently non-speaking; no individually attributed dialogue or voice actor was found in the [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Where_the_Apple_Lies).
- **Appearances:** Confirmed by the character index in *Where the Apple Lies* (S6E23, October 8, 2016). No further television, film, comic, or game appearance was verified.

## Important moments

- **The mistaken operation — [Where the Apple Lies](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/where-the-apple-lies/umc.cmc.4htcc5f1z702cklezxhdtz89a?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) (S6E23):** Pinkheart appears among the hospital doctors during the misunderstanding that nearly leads Granny Smith to operate on Big Mac, prompting Applejack to confess her lies.
